title: Abba, Son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Sotah 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.49a.10). Rav Huna found a fat date and gave it to Rabbah his son. Abba his son came, and Rabbah gave it to Abba. And Rav Huna said to his son, 'You have gladdened my heart and set my teeth on edge' — but Hyman infers from [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Sotah.49a.10.3) that his reading was simply 'his son came' (without the name Abba).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Abba in this part of the story. The linked Rashi starts his gloss with “his son came” and explains that he is the son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna. The linked English describes the date as fragrant, while Hyman calls it fat. Hyman infers from the shorter wording that the name Abba was absent from Rashi’s text.
